full_name: Susan A. Murphy | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 Mathematics Radcliffe Alumnae Professor Harvard University
bio: Susan A. Murphy is a statistician and computer scientist whose lab develops data analysis methods and experimental designs to improve real-time sequential decision making in mobile health—in particular, algorithms that can be deployed on wearable devices.
